'''Aine 26 (April 10)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[998 NE]] - [[Perrin]] and [[Egwene]], and [[Elyas]] encounter a [[Tuatha'an|Tinker]] caravan and decide to travel with them.
*[[1000 NE]] - The [[Battle of Malden]] occurs, resulting in the rescue of [[Faile]] and her party, the defeat of the [[Shaido]], and the capture of [[Sevanna]] by the [[Seanchan]]. [[Galina]] who tries escaping, is recaptured by [[Therava]], finally broken, and taken back to the [[Aiel Waste]].
